summary.en: A 540-billion-parameter language model scaled efficiently across 6,144 TPU v4 chips with Pathways
summary.zh: 通过 Pathways 在 6,144 个 TPU v4 芯片上高效扩展的 5,400 亿参数语言模型

description.en:
PaLM tested whether a single dense language model could be trained efficiently at 540 billion parameters using Google's Pathways system. The work used 6,144 TPU v4 chips and a 780-billion-token multilingual corpus, pairing systems engineering with a broad evaluation program.

As scale increased, PaLM improved few-shot language understanding, generation, reasoning and code tasks, while also showing discontinuous gains on some capabilities. The project became an important reference point for both large-model infrastructure and discussions of emergent behavior.
description.zh:
PaLM 检验了能否借助 Google 的 Pathways 系统高效训练一个 5,400 亿参数的稠密语言模型。该工作使用 6,144 个 TPU v4 芯片和 7,800 亿 token 的多语种语料，把系统工程与广泛评测结合起来。

随着规模增加，PaLM 在少样本语言理解、生成、推理和代码任务上持续提升，并在部分能力上出现不连续跃升。该项目因此成为大模型基础设施和涌现能力讨论的重要参照。

role.en: First author of the PaLM paper

notes.en: Completed 2022 event research with primary-source verification, localized narrative, portrait decision, original explainer and audience quiz.
notes.zh: 已完成 2022 年事件研究，包括一手资料核验、双语正文、肖像选择结论、原创解释图和观众 quiz。
